cards.back:
The work of collecting and reporting the news.
Bahasa Indonesia: jurnalisme
Example: Good journalism checks the facts before telling the story.
cards.say: journalism. Good journalism checks the facts before telling the story.

cards.back:
A person who checks and corrects what is published.
Bahasa Indonesia: editor
Example: The editor changed the headline to make it clearer.
cards.say: editor. The editor changed the headline to make it clearer.

cards.back:
A reporter who sends news from a faraway place.
Bahasa Indonesia: koresponden
Example: The correspondent reported live from the flooded town.
cards.say: correspondent. The correspondent reported live from the flooded town.

cards.back:
A meeting in which someone asks questions to get information.
Bahasa Indonesia: wawancara
Example: The reporter held an interview with the winning athlete.
cards.say: interview. The reporter held an interview with the winning athlete.

cards.back:
The title in large print above a news story.
Bahasa Indonesia: judul berita
Example: A bold headline announced the new bridge opening.
cards.say: headline. A bold headline announced the new bridge opening.

cards.back:
A piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine.
Bahasa Indonesia: artikel
Example: I read an article about turtles in the weekend paper.
cards.say: article. I read an article about turtles in the weekend paper.

cards.back:
An article that gives the opinion of the newspaper.
Bahasa Indonesia: tajuk rencana
Example: The editorial argued that the town needs more cycle paths.
cards.say: editorial. The editorial argued that the town needs more cycle paths.

cards.back:
An unfair preference for one side.
Bahasa Indonesia: bias, keberpihakan
Example: The story showed bias because it mentioned only one team's view.
cards.say: bias. The story showed bias because it mentioned only one team's view.

cards.back:
Something that can be proved true.
Bahasa Indonesia: fakta
Example: It is a fact that the Earth takes a year to orbit the Sun.
cards.say: fact. It is a fact that the Earth takes a year to orbit the Sun.

cards.back:
What a person thinks or believes, which may not be proved.
Bahasa Indonesia: pendapat
Example: In my opinion, the second film was better than the first.
cards.say: opinion. In my opinion, the second film was better than the first.

cards.back:
Facts or signs that show something is true.
Bahasa Indonesia: bukti
Example: The scientist showed evidence that the river was becoming cleaner.
cards.say: evidence. The scientist showed evidence that the river was becoming cleaner.

cards.back:
A person or place that gives information.
Bahasa Indonesia: sumber
Example: The reporter named her source at the town hall.
cards.say: source. The reporter named her source at the town hall.

cards.back:
Wrong information that spreads, often by mistake.
Bahasa Indonesia: informasi keliru
Example: Misinformation spread fast after someone shared the wrong date.
cards.say: misinformation. Misinformation spread fast after someone shared the wrong date.

cards.back:
Stopping people from seeing or saying certain things.
Bahasa Indonesia: sensor (pembatasan informasi)
Example: Censorship removed the report before it could be read.
cards.say: censorship. Censorship removed the report before it could be read.

cards.back:
To print or put something online for the public to read.
Bahasa Indonesia: menerbitkan
Example: The magazine will publish my story next month.
cards.say: publish. The magazine will publish my story next month.

cards.back:
The number of copies of a newspaper that are sold.
Bahasa Indonesia: oplah
Example: The newspaper has a circulation of fifty thousand copies.
cards.say: circulation. The newspaper has a circulation of fifty thousand copies.

cards.back:
A writer who has a regular article in a paper.
Bahasa Indonesia: kolumnis
Example: The columnist writes a funny piece about school life every Friday.
cards.say: columnist. The columnist writes a funny piece about school life every Friday.

cards.back:
Words written under a picture to explain it.
Bahasa Indonesia: keterangan gambar
Example: The caption told us who was in the photograph.
cards.say: caption. The caption told us who was in the photograph.

cards.back:
The line that gives the name of the writer of an article.
Bahasa Indonesia: nama penulis
Example: The byline showed that my aunt wrote the story.
cards.say: byline. The byline showed that my aunt wrote the story.

cards.back:
News that has just happened and is reported at once.
Bahasa Indonesia: berita terkini
Example: Breaking news interrupted the show with a report on a storm.
cards.say: breaking news. Breaking news interrupted the show with a report on a storm.

cards.back:
A film that tells facts about real events or people.
Bahasa Indonesia: film dokumenter
Example: The documentary showed how bees make honey from flower nectar.
cards.say: documentary. The documentary showed how bees make honey from flower nectar.

cards.back:
A meeting where officials answer questions from reporters.
Bahasa Indonesia: konferensi pers
Example: The mayor spoke at a press conference about the new park.
cards.say: press conference. The mayor spoke at a press conference about the new park.

cards.back:
Spreading very quickly on the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: viral
Example: The video of the singing dog went viral in one day.
cards.say: viral. The video of the singing dog went viral in one day.
